prompt: How many years had the then-Prime Minister of France been in office as PM when the first Shelby GT500 was built?
answer:
The first Shelby GT500 was built in **1967**. France’s prime minister at the time was **Georges Pompidou**, who had been in office since **April 14, 1962**.

Thus, he had been prime minister for **about 4 years and 9 months—nearly five years**.
